exact_exclusion_agreement.definition: September 19 and September 20 exclusion categories are identical.

binary_exclusion_agreement.definition: Both sittings agree whether exclusion is none.

directional_exclusion_changes.definition: Among changed exact exclusion labels, count none to an excluded category.

none_to_excluded.definition: Changed exclusion labels moving from none to excluded.

excluded_to_none.definition: Changed exclusion labels moving from excluded to none.

category_to_category.definition: Changed exclusion labels moving between two excluded categories.

disposition_agreement.definition: September 19 disposition equals September 20 derived route; disposition fused content and reply preference.

review_to_respond_already_substantive.definition: Among September 19 review cases that route to respond in September 20, count those already banded substantive.

primary_concordance.definition: Among September 19 substantive or pointer bands, count September 20 substance in_post or pointer respectively, including nulls as disagreement.

posthoc_stable_exclusion_concordance.definition: Apply the primary band-to-substance concordance only where both exclusions are none.

stable_exclusion_disposition_rate.definition: Among cases with identical exclusion categories, compare September 19 disposition with September 20 derived route.

preregistered_floor.definition: Minimum acceptable complete-chain exact agreements approved before the repeat sitting.

complete_decision_agreement.definition: The complete exclusion/substance decision matches exactly between first and second rounds.

exact_exclusion_agreement.definition: Exact exclusion category agrees across rounds.

binary_exclusion_agreement.definition: Both rounds agree whether the case is excluded.

substance_agreement_among_both_nonexclud.definition: Substance agrees where exclusion is none in both rounds.

derived_route_agreement.definition: Derived respond/review/drop route agrees across rounds.

label_different_route_same.definition: Among differing complete decisions, derived route stays the same.

substance_changes.definition: Substance changes while both rounds have exclusion none.

substance_changes_toward_none.definition: Among substance changes, the second-round substance is none.

exclusion_changes_with_note.definition: Exclusion changes with a second-round note.

differing_cases_with_second_round_note.definition: Differing complete decisions with a second-round note.

substance_changes_with_note.definition: Substance changes with a second-round note.

substance_changes_where_note_names_earli.definition: Substance changes whose valid split note names the first-round substance.

reading_correction_by_later_clarificatio.definition: The one manually checked post-submission clarification marks case 63 as a likely reading correction.

exclusion_changes_with_note.definition: Exclusion changes with a second-round note.

exclusion_changes_unexplained.definition: Exclusion changes without a second-round note.

action_changing_exclusion_changes_unexpl.definition: Route-changing exclusion differences without a second-round note.

agreeing_cases_with_split_note.definition: Valid split-note cases whose complete decision held.

split_note_cases_total.definition: Cases with a valid second-round two-label numeric split note.

split_note_cases_that_held.definition: Valid split-note cases whose complete decision held.

complete_decision_within_stated_uncertai.definition: Exact agreements plus substance differences whose valid split note names the earlier answer; exploratory sensitivity reading.
Prior sensitivity reading plus the single likely reading correction from a later clarification; exploratory only.
